title: Mwatate farmers demonstrate against threatened eviction from disputed ranch land
location: Maktau shopping centre and the Voi–Taveta Highway toward a site at Isanga-Iwishi ranch, Mwatate Sub-County, Taita Taveta, Kenya
threshold_50_evidence: The KNA article says more than 300 farmers demonstrated, which, if accurate, exceeds 50. It is a single-source estimate, not independently corroborated (KEN202102-S090).

occurrence.summary: The opened KNA article reports Maktau farmers demonstrating against eviction threats and alleged land appropriation connected with Isanga-Iwishi ranch; it is one contemporary account.

start_date.summary: The article is dated 2021-02-22 and says the demonstration happened on Saturday; 2021-02-20 is inferred from that report date and calendar weekday, not independently confirmed.

location.summary: The article says farmers marched from Maktau shopping centre along the Voi–Taveta Highway toward a ranch site; exact assembly point is not specified.

demands.summary: The report describes action against threatened eviction and alleged ranch land appropriation (land/farm issue). The article quotes allegations of ministry collusion but does not establish that a demand was directed to government or state policy; target remains uncertain.

participants_original.summary: The article reports more than 300 farmers in the demonstration.

participants_min.summary: More than 300 reported participants supports a lower bound of 301 if the account is accurate.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The one reported crowd estimate is above 300 and therefore exceeds 50; independent corroboration is absent.

state_response.summary: The report says police intercepted the march citing absence of a local-administration permit and a county commissioner calmed residents and referred them to land agencies. It does not establish accommodation/concession, dispersal, arrests, beatings, killings, shootings or ignoring; all coded dimensions remain unknown.

protester_violence.summary: The scoped article does not describe protester violence; silence is not coded as no_explicit.

end_date.summary: The article does not establish when the gathering physically ended.

organizer.summary: No organizer is identified in the scoped article.

notes: One KNA account reports a crowd above 300 and an event date inferred as 2021-02-20 from “Saturday” in its 2021-02-22 publication. The dispute is described as one with a private ranch; the Ministry of Lands allegation is not itself evidence that protesters demanded government action. State target remains unresolved. No end, organizer, protester violence, independent corroboration or categorical response is established.
open_questions: Was 2021-02-20 the event date, and can a contemporaneous source independently confirm it?
Was the explicit demand directed to the Kenyan state or a state policy, or only to private ranch actors?
Is there independent reporting that corroborates the event and reported crowd above 300?
Who organized the gathering and what was its precise assembly location?
When did the physical gathering end?
Were any response dimensions or protester violence explicitly reported?
